-- Liaisons avec noms exacts (anglais/français)
INSERT IGNORE INTO tps_gene_molecules (tps_gene_id, molecule_id, relationship_type, confidence, source_reference, notes)
SELECT tg.id, m.id, 'primary_product', 'high', 'Nomenclature TPS - Produit principal', CONCAT('Liaison: ', tg.name, ' → ', m.name)
FROM tps_genes tg, molecules m
WHERE 
  -- Monoterpènes
  (tg.name LIKE '%Bornéol synthase%' AND m.name IN ('Borneol', 'Bornéol'))
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%Camphène synthase%' AND m.name IN ('Camphene', 'Camphène'))
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%Cédrol synthase%' AND m.name IN ('Cédrol', 'Cedarol'))
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%Agarospirol synthase%' AND m.name = 'Agarospirol')
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%Aromadendrène synthase%' AND m.name = 'Aromadendrene')
  -- Sesquiterpènes
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%Curcumène synthase%' AND m.name = 'Alpha-curcumene')
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%Eudesmol synthase%' AND m.name LIKE '%eudesmol%')
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%Guaiol synthase%' AND m.name LIKE '%guaiol%')
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%Caryophyllène oxide synthase%' AND m.name = 'Caryophyllène oxide')
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%Epi-β-santalène synthase%' AND m.name = 'Epi-β-santalène')
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%Elemol synthase%' AND m.name LIKE '%elemol%')
  -- Alpha/Beta variants
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%Bisabolène synthase%' AND m.name LIKE '%bisabolene%')
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%santalène synthase%' AND m.name LIKE '%santalene%')
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%cedrene synthase%' AND m.name LIKE '%cedrene%')
